root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `GeneratePskc()` copies `aNetworkName` into the fixed-size PBKDF2 salt, `strlen(aNetworkName)` must not exceed `OT_NETWORK_NAME_MAX_SIZE`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original validates only the passphrase length and still reaches the stack `salt` copy with a 17-byte network name. The fixed program enforces the missing network-name upper bound and still permits the exact 16-byte boundary name that fits the salt layout.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original violates this predicate at the protected sink execution (`17 > 16`). The fixed original is guarded on the original witness, and the nearest valid boundary perturbation `network_name_len16_boundary` executes the same protected event genuinely with `16 <= 16`.

nodes.state: Immediately before the ASan-reported `memcpy`, the requested network-name copy end offset `saltLen + strlen(aNetworkName)` exceeds the 30-byte `salt` buffer size `sizeof(salt)`.
nodes.evidence: In the vulnerable original trace, `network_name_copy_sink.copy_end_offset > network_name_copy_sink.salt_buffer_size` (31 > 30).

edges.relation: The same network-name pointer checked at the missing guard site is passed unchanged as the source pointer of the `memcpy` sink.
edges.evidence: The frozen traces record `network_name_guard.network_name_ptr == network_name_copy_sink.copy_source_ptr` whenever the sink executes.

edges.relation: The same network-name length that should satisfy the root bound is reused unchanged as the `memcpy` copy length.
edges.evidence: The frozen traces record `network_name_guard.network_name_length == network_name_copy_sink.copy_length` whenever the sink executes (17 on the crashing original, 16 on the boundary witness).
